user_goal.text: For each person in owe_list.csv, privately send the specified amount and description by Venmo if they have an account; otherwise create an individual, non-grouped Splitwise expense with the same details and attach the corresponding PDF receipt.

benchmark_success.rationale: The frozen TestTracker succeeds only when every registered test passes.

checked_by.text: The official AppWorld evaluate function and TestTracker compare the submitted answer and retained start/end model state against all registered requirements; success requires pass_count to equal num_tests.

decisive_artifacts.artifact: Retained submitted answer and official evaluator comparison result
decisive_artifacts.question: Does the retained evaluator result show that the registered answer-comparison test passed?

decisive_artifacts.artifact: Retained start/end database diff and official TestTracker results
decisive_artifacts.question: Do the retained diff and evaluator results show that every registered database-state test passed, including required records, values, privacy, relationships, allowed change sets, and protected-file constraints?
